Prototype 8 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (84%), with EOG (12%) and EMG (4%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+8.4 dB, sensitivity=4.0) and elevated σ_h (+8.3 dB, sensitivity=3.4).
The δ activity is present in 66% of each epoch (intermittent), with active eye movements (SEM 62% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and tonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, σ relevant; missing: EOG quiescent.
